equity.level_reason: Racial disparity is framed and discussed, with SES, education and access named as possible causes, but group medians and slopes are only set side by side; no between-race difference or ratio is computed, so the cap at 2 applies.

level_alternative.reason: Medians (50 vs 25 years) and slopes (1.9 vs 0.7) quantify the gap clearly, are interpreted as a disparity, and specific social determinants are offered as explanations.
